description: Multi-cloud pricing comparison MCP server for AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI
author: Jason Wilbur

tool_signatures.name: calculate_workload_cost
tool_signatures.description: Estimate total monthly cost for a workload across all cloud providers. Includes compute, storage, egress, and Kubernetes.

tool_signatures.name: check_api_status
tool_signatures.description: Check if the real-time pricing APIs (Azure, OCI, AWS) are accessible.

tool_signatures.name: compare_compute
tool_signatures.description: Compare VM/instance pricing across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI. Finds instances matching your vCPU and memory requirements.

tool_signatures.name: compare_egress
tool_signatures.description: Compare data transfer/egress costs. OCI offers 10TB/month free (100x more than others)!

tool_signatures.name: compare_gpu_shapes
tool_signatures.description: Compare multiple OCI GPU shapes side-by-side on specs, pricing, and price-per-GPU metrics.

tool_signatures.name: compare_kubernetes
tool_signatures.description: Compare managed Kubernetes pricing (EKS, AKS, GKE, OKE). Shows control plane and worker node costs.

tool_signatures.name: compare_storage
tool_signatures.description: Compare object and block storage pricing across all clouds.

tool_signatures.name: data-lake
tool_signatures.description: 16 vCPU, 128GB RAM, 100TB object storage, 5TB egress

tool_signatures.name: estimate_migration_savings

tool_signatures.name: find_cheapest_compute

tool_signatures.name: get_aws_lightsail_pricing

tool_signatures.name: get_data_freshness
